what: Pressing the menu button unfolds a full-screen panel that sits folded at the top edge (clip-path bottom 100%) downward over .5s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), and the button’s two lines turn into a crossed X. Pressing again, clicking a link in the panel or pressing Esc folds it back up with the same curve. Page scroll is locked while it is open

options.dur: Open and close duration (s), default .5 — shorten it for screens that open and close often
options.ease: Curve — numbers like ”0.19,1,0.22,1” (default) or a css name
options.look: If ”up”, it stays folded at the bottom edge and unfolds upward (bottom tab bar menu)
options.lock: If ”none”, page scroll is not locked while open
options.shift: Distance (px) the folded panel sits shifted upward — as it unfolds it drops into place on the same curve, default 0 · Brand 30
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Open/close button (child) — inside, [data-fx-part=open-icon]·[data-fx-part=If close-icon] is placed, it changes as it opens
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Panel to unfold (child) — position, size and background are up to the user (usually position: fixed; inset: 0)
options.fx:open·fx:close: Events fired from the element on open and close — stop and restart lenis here
options.delay: Delay before unfolding (s), default 0 — no delay when folding
options.close-ease: Fold curve — a source value different from the unfold one (a number like ”0.87,0,0.13,1” or a css name), same as the default ease

note: While closed, the panel turns visibility off (after folding ends) so keyboard focus doesn’t go to hidden links
